title: Lively German Pork Skewers
description: A sour and snappy German dish featuring pomegranate molasses, this recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters, and the use of a copper pot adds a touch of elegance to the presentation. The low-carb friendly ingredients make it a great option for those watching their carb intake.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure the grates are clean and brush them with oil to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, whisk together pomegranate molasses, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it sit for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Soak the wooden skewers in brine for at least 30 minutes to prevent them from burning on the grill.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Transfer the skewers to a copper pot and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a side of roasted vegetables.
Make sure to cook the pork to an internal temperature of at least 145 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure food safety.
